analysis.headline: USD/KRW eases to 1,335 on post-FOMC yield cooling and month-end selling
analysis.summary: USD/KRW dropped toward 1,335 (ECB ref 1,335.27) as lower Treasury yields post-FOMC and broad dollar softness coincided with heavy month-end dollar selling from semiconductor exporters. Although foreign equity outflows from KOSPI triggered custody dollar demand, futures selling helped cap rallies, leaving the pair within 1,333–1,338 KRW.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW climbs to 1,491 as weaker dollar lifts euro above 1.117
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW rebounded toward 1,491 (ECB ref 1,491.76) as broad U.S. dollar softening lifted EUR/USD to near 1.1172. Although the ECB's decision to keep its deposit facility rate at 2.50% and subdued manufacturing activity cap euro gains, dollar pullback outweighed headwinds, driving the cross firmly into the 1,488–1,495 KRW range.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW rebounds to 849 KRW per 100 JPY as USD/JPY pulls back to 157
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW rebounded to near 8.49 KRW per 1 JPY (~849.1 KRW per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.491). With the Bank of Japan maintaining its policy rate at 1.25% and USD/JPY retreating from near 158 back to 157.0, verbal intervention warnings from Tokyo alongside lower Treasury yields helped the yen defend the 846–852 KRW zone.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW advances to 1,789 as cable extends gains on dollar cooling
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW rallied toward 1,789 (ECB ref 1,789.11) as sterling pushed up to 1.3386 against the softer U.S. dollar. While expectations of upcoming Bank of England rate reductions and caution surrounding the UK Autumn Budget keep gains in check, dollar consolidation provided strong tailwinds, anchoring the pair between 1,784 and 1,794 KRW.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW holds near 200.7 on PBOC liquidity support and stimulus watch
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW trades steadily around 200.7 (ECB ref 200.71) within a 200–202 band. The People's Bank of China maintained accommodative liquidity support and a steady daily midpoint fixing, while expectations of further fiscal stimulus anchored the yuan. As USD/KRW settled toward 1,335, the cross traded in an orderly 200.5–201.2 range.

AUD.headline: Aussie dollar holds near 938 KRW on steady RBA stance and commodity support
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar remains steady near 938 KRW, backed by the RBA's hawkish rate hold and stable commodity prices alongside China stimulus optimism.

CAD.headline: Loonie defends 956 KRW as crude rebound cushions Bank of Canada rate gap
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar holds resilient near 956 KRW as rebounding crude oil prices offset widening yield differentials stemming from Bank of Canada rate cuts.

CHF.headline: Swiss franc advances to 1,622 KRW on persistent safe-haven inflows
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc strengthened toward 1,622 KRW as safe-haven bids spurred by Middle East tensions and European fiscal caution outweighed low SNB interest rates.

CNY.headline: Chinese yuan steadies near 200.7 KRW amid PBOC liquidity and stimulus hopes
CNY.brief: The yuan holds stable around 200.7 KRW as the PBOC maintains ample liquidity and stable daily fixings while markets await fiscal stimulus deployment.

EUR.headline: Euro rebounds to 1,491 KRW driven by EUR/USD gains despite ECB hold
EUR.brief: The euro rebounded to 1,491 KRW as EUR/USD rose above 1.117 on dollar softening, overcoming subdued manufacturing momentum and the ECB's 2.50% rate hold.

GBP.headline: British pound climbs to 1,789 KRW on cable rally despite budget caution
GBP.brief: Sterling advanced to 1,789 KRW tracking cable's rise to 1.338, even as expectations of BoE rate cuts and fiscal prudence ahead of the Autumn Budget linger.

HKD.headline: Hong Kong dollar stable near 170.2 KRW tracking greenback ease
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar traded calmly near 170.2 KRW within its 7.75–7.85 peg band, closely mirroring U.S. dollar easing and regional equity capital flows.

JPY.headline: Japanese yen rebounds to 849 KRW per 100 JPY on USD/JPY retreat to 157
JPY.brief: The yen recovered to 849 KRW per 100 JPY as the BOJ held rates at 1.25%, USD/JPY pulled back toward 157.0, and Tokyo maintained verbal intervention warnings.

KRW.headline: Korean won firms to 1,335 KRW on month-end export settlements and BOK anchor
KRW.brief: The won strengthened toward 1,335 as heavy month-end semiconductor export dollar sales and the BOK's 3.00% base rate offset foreign equity outflows in Seoul.

USD.headline: U.S. dollar softens to 1,335 KRW on Treasury yield ease and exporter selling
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar pulled back to 1,335 KRW as post-FOMC Treasury yield moderation and active month-end corporate export conversions curtailed upward momentum.
